about: Wrong answers that point to a specific misunderstanding about integers. 'pointsTo' is the subskill to work on.

misconceptions.description: Adds two negatives and drops the sign (−3 + −5 = 8).
Gets the size right but the sign wrong when adding a positive and a negative (−7 + 4 = 3).
Adds the sizes when the signs are different (−7 + 4 = −11).
Ignores the second number's sign when subtracting (4 − (−6) = −2; −5 − 7 = 2).
Subtracts the smaller number from the bigger one (3 − 8 = 5).
Gets the size right but the sign wrong when subtracting.
Gets the sign wrong when multiplying (−6 × −7 = −42).
Gets the sign wrong when dividing (−42 ÷ −7 = −6).
